description: This file defines data structures and a manager for handling variables, including static and dynamic components, within a debugging context. It also provides functions to create and retrieve variables objects.

classes.name: Variables
classes.description: Aggregates static and dynamic variables for debugging.

classes.name: VariablesManager
classes.description: Manages static variables and provides access to combined Variables object.

methods.name: NewVariablesManager
methods.description: Constructor to create a new VariablesManager with provided static variables.

methods.name: GetVariables
methods.description: Returns a Variables object that includes static variables.
